newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE SUPERVISOR TO RESIGN SOON - FOTIADIS.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE SUPERVISOR TO RESIGN SOON - FOTIADIS.

text.p: Athens bourse trade supervisor George Malakis wil be replaced soon following his letter of resignation, national economy ministry general secretary Apostolos Fotiadis said on Tuesday.
Fotiadis confirmed that Malakis had submitted a resignation letter to the ministry requesting to be replaced from his post.
In his letter, Malakis noted that he had made a series of proposals to the ministry on improving operations at the Athens stock exchange but none had been accepted.
When asked earlier on Tuesday to confirm or dismiss press reports that he intended to resign, Malakis said "No comment."
Fotiadis did not provide any information on the person likely to replace Malakis. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
